name: Wildwood Berry Farm
description: A family-run pumpkin patch in 977 Mad Tom Rd, VT, Wildwood Berry Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples. The patch is busiest in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
